meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

howto.what: Claude 会给幻灯片、文档、报告、网页等成品套用配色和字体主题。它有 10 套预设主题,也能按你的描述当场生成新主题,应用前先展示主题样式供你确认。
howto.when: 当你要求给幻灯片、文档等成品换主题时会触发。Claude 会先展示主题图片、等你选定,再把对应颜色字体应用上去;若现有主题都不合适,可按描述创新主题。

say.text: 给这套幻灯片套用『Ocean Depths』主题。
say.note: Claude 会应用对应配色和字体。

say.text: 帮我新建一个以森林绿色为主的主题。
say.note: 会生成新主题并展示给你确认。

say.text: 看看有哪些可用主题?先展示一下主题图。
say.note: Claude 会展示主题一览图。

howto.what_en: Claude will apply color and font themes to finished artifacts like slides, docs, reports, or landing pages. It has 10 preset themes and can also generate a new one on the fly, showing the showcase first for confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to restyle an artifact with a theme. Claude shows the theme showcase, waits for your pick, then applies colors/fonts; if none fit, it can create a custom theme from your description.

say_en.text: Apply the 'Ocean Depths' theme to this slide deck.
say_en.note: Claude applies the matching colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Create a new theme with forest green as the main color.
say_en.note: It generates a theme and shows it for review.

say_en.text: Show me the theme showcase to see available options.
